messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- There is a deploy freeze on the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly and no longer depends on the ledger. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-10]
- The scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- Do not upgrade the ledger service past Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes. [constraint; valid 2025-09-12 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-12]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder reported that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- During INC-2025-011, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26. [valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-01-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-29]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan. [decision; valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- On 2026-01-05, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-01-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-05]
- The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- As a follow-up to INC-2026-009, the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-13]

Question: What is the deploy window of the service that the ledger depends on?

message.content: Weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays (auth gateway).
message.reasoning:
The question asks: what is the deploy window of the service that the ledger depends on?

The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens. So the ledger depends on the auth gateway. The auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.

Answer: weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC (never on Fridays).
